CustomField.label: Header Display
CustomField.description: How a section renders its header: the standard header card, or a divider in the style chosen in Divider Style. Blank is treated as Header.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose how this section's header is rendered. "Header" (or blank) renders the standard header card; "Divider" renders the header's icon, title and subtitle in the divider style selected in Divider Style.
